purpose: Classifies the Horizons system release behind each Horizons-derived artifact without editing hash-bound artifacts. New artifacts carry their own horizons_system_release block.

classes.recorded: the artifact carries a horizons_system_release block read when it was generated
classes.inferred: every retrieval is on or after the release date of a release still current at observation, so no later release can have served it
classes.unrecorded: retrieved before that release, or no retrieval date; the release then in service is not known

observed_release.evidence: Read from the manual's Introduction ('Version 4.98e (August 25, 2026)') on 2026-10-31 through a web-fetch tool during this review, not by fetch_system_release. A Horizons query response carries only 'API VERSION: 1.2' and a per-object 'Revised' date, never the system release.
